protocol.copyright: AbyssBSD Swift DE. Same terms as the rest of the tree.

description.summary: window operations xdg-shell does not have

protocol.description:
xdg-shell lets a client ask to be moved, resized, maximized, minimized and made fullscreen, and never to be sent behind other windows — the depth gadget a window frame may carry (PHASE11.md P11.6). A client that draws its own frame asks undertow here; a frame undertow draws for a client acts directly.
The compositor decides. A request is a request: a compositor may ignore it, and a client must not assume its window moved.

interface.name: abyss_window_manager_v1
interface.description: A global with no events. Bind it, and ask.

request.name: lower

description.summary: send a toplevel to the back

request.description: Put the toplevel behind every other window. If it had the keyboard, the window now in front gets it: a window put away is not the one being typed into. The toplevel must be one of this client's.

request.name: window_at

description.summary: which window is at a point, and where it is

request.description:
Ask which window is topmost at (x, y), in the layout's coordinates — what Grab's Window mode clicks on (PHASE15 P15.6). The answer is one event on `query`: `window` with its box — the frame the compositor draws around it included — or `none`. The client then destroys it.
Geometry is less than wlr-screencopy already gives any client (every pixel of the screen), so this is not a privileged request.

interface.name: abyss_window_query_v1
interface.description: Answered once, with `window` or `none`, as soon as it is made.

event.name: window
event.description: Its box in the layout's coordinates, the compositor's frame included, and what it calls itself.
